links.outcome: ChatGPT vs support staff response quality and empathy on the same patient questions
links.effect: No quality difference (p = 0.075); ChatGPT rated more empathetic (p < 0.001); no difference in risk of incorrect treatment (p = 0.377).
links.quote: No quality difference was found (p = 0.075) between ChatGPT and support staff, though ChatGPT was rated as more empathetic (p < 0.001).

links.outcome: High-risk errors in ChatGPT-generated replies to patient questions
links.effect: Three ChatGPT responses showed high-risk errors among 50 compared, with no difference from support staff in risk of incorrect treatment (p = 0.377).
links.quote: Three ChatGPT responses showed high-risk errors.

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation comparing ChatGPT-generated responses to medical support staff responses for orthopaedic patient queries, evaluated by physicians and patients without testing a specific deployment practice/safeguard.
